description: Set up a complete Jenkins CI environment for a new software project called 'Project Alpha'. You must create two build jobs: 'alpha-backend-build' (a Pipeline job that clones source code from https://github.com/jenkinsci/pipeline-examples on the master branch and automatically polls SCM every 15 minutes using hash-based scheduling) and 'alpha-frontend-build' (a job that accepts a NODE_VERSION choice parameter with options 16, 18, and 20 in that order, and discards old builds keeping only the last 7). You must also provision a secret-text credential named 'npm-registry-token' to store the NPM authentication token, and create a list view called 'Project-Alpha CI' that contains both build jobs so the team can monitor the whole project from a single dashboard. Jenkins URL: http://localhost:8080 — Login: admin / Admin123!
